_howto: ESS Master how-to guides. mode click = the user clicks the real button. optional = skipped when that part isn't on screen. guideOnly = left out of the pop-up form tours. Never reuse a step id.

guides.title: Approve or reject a request
guides.blurb: Find a leave, overtime or profile request and approve or reject it.

steps.title: Mobile Requests
steps.text: Requests wait here. Click it.

steps.title: 1. Find it
steps.text: Filter by date, department or employee, then click Filter.

steps.title: 2. Check the request
steps.text: Who, what they asked for, their balance, and which approval step it's on.

steps.title: 3. Approve or reject
steps.text: Click Approve or Reject on the request.

steps.title: The request
steps.text: What was asked for, and when.

steps.title: Proof
steps.text: Any document or photo sent with it, such as a sick note.

steps.title: Leave type to deduct
steps.text: Which balance the leave comes from. Change it if they chose the wrong type.

steps.title: Partial hours
steps.text: For part of a day only, the number of hours. Leave empty for the full day.

steps.title: Approve or Reject
steps.text: Approve moves it to the next approval step, or finishes it if this was the last one. Reject ends it and tells the employee.

steps.title: Many at once
steps.text: Tick several requests and use Bulk Approve.

guides.title: Set up a payroll period and send to payroll
guides.blurb: Create a pay cycle, put departments and people on it, lock it, and send approved leave and claims.

steps.title: Payroll
steps.text: Payroll periods live here. Click it.

steps.title: New Period
steps.text: Click New Period.

steps.title: Name
steps.text: For example Monthly Staff or Weekly Pickers.

steps.title: Cycle
steps.text: Monthly, Weekly or Fortnightly.

steps.title: Monthly: start day and pay day
steps.text: The day of the month each period starts (1 to 28), and the day people are paid.

steps.title: Weekly or fortnightly: the first day
steps.text: The first day of any one cycle, and how many days after the cycle ends people are paid. Every cycle is counted from this date.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: Saves the period. Click Save (or Cancel if you're only practising), then Next.

steps.title: Who is on it
steps.text: On the period: Units puts whole departments on it, and Override puts individual people on it whatever their department. Lock a window here once its payroll is final.

steps.title: Send To Payroll
steps.text: On the Send To Payroll tab, choose the period and window.

steps.title: What Would Send
steps.text: Check everything that would go: approved leave and claims not sent yet.

steps.title: Mark As Sent
steps.text: After the preview, Mark As Sent records the batch; those items never go again unless you unsend it. Download the batch from the list for payroll.

guides.title: Publish a document
guides.blurb: Upload a policy or notice for everyone, a department or one person, and see who has read it.

steps.title: Document Center
steps.text: Documents live here. Click it.

steps.title: Upload Document
steps.text: Click Upload Document.

steps.title: Title and version
steps.text: The document's name, and its version, for example v2 when you replace an older one.

steps.title: Description
steps.text: What it is and anything employees must do, for example read and acknowledge by a date.

steps.title: Tags
steps.text: Words to group and filter documents by, such as Safety or HR.

steps.title: Who gets it
steps.text: Global (all employees), Specific Department or Specific Employee. Then choose which.

steps.title: The file
steps.text: Choose the document to upload.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: Publishes it to the employees' self-service. Click Save (or Cancel if you're only practising).

steps.title: Who has read it
steps.text: The list shows how many acknowledged it. Track shows who has and who hasn't.

guides.title: Set up leave: type, policy and departments
guides.blurb: Add a leave type, give it rules in a leave policy, and link the policy to departments.

steps.title: 1. Leave Types
steps.text: Start with the leave type. Click Leave Types.

steps.title: Add Leave Type
steps.text: Click Add Leave Type.

steps.title: Leave Name
steps.text: For example Annual Leave.

steps.title: Paid and active
steps.text: Whether it's paid leave, and whether people can use it now.

steps.title: When proof is needed
steps.text: Ask for an attachment (such as a doctor's note) when the request is longer than this many days (0 = never), or when it touches a Monday or Friday, a public holiday or payday.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: Click Save (or Cancel if you're only practising), then Next.

steps.title: 2. Leave Policies
steps.text: Now the rules. Click Leave Policies.

steps.title: New Policy
steps.text: Click New Policy (or open an existing policy to add the type to it).

steps.title: Policy Name and description
steps.text: For example Permanent Staff, and what it's for.

steps.title: Kind
steps.text: Custom configuration or a predefined pack.

steps.title: Effective From
steps.text: The date the policy starts.

steps.title: Start as a copy
steps.text: Copy another policy's rules to save time. The original isn't touched.

steps.title: Create Policy
steps.text: Creates the policy as a draft and opens it. Click Create Policy (or Cancel if practising), then Next.

steps.title: The rules
steps.text: Tick In Policy for each leave type it covers, and set its entitlement, cycle, how it builds up, how far negative it may go, who is eligible, and when proof or HR is needed.

steps.title: Save Draft and Publish
steps.text: Save the draft while you work, then Publish to make it live from its start date.

steps.title: 3. Pack Linkage
steps.text: Last, give the policy to departments. Click Pack Linkage.

steps.title: Policy and date
steps.text: Choose the policy and the date it applies from.

steps.title: Departments
steps.text: Tick the departments. Everyone in them, including new starters, gets this policy.

steps.title: Preview, then Apply
steps.text: Preview shows what changes for each person. Then Apply Linkage.

guides.title: Load opening leave balances
guides.blurb: Bring in everyone's leave balances (or leave already taken) from a spreadsheet, checked before loading.

steps.title: Leave Take-On
steps.text: Click Leave Take-On.

steps.title: 1. Template
steps.text: Download the template and fill it in: employee, leave type and value. Columns are matched by name.

steps.title: 2. What you're loading
steps.text: Opening balances, or historic transactions (leave already taken).

steps.title: 3. Batch Name
steps.text: A name you'll recognise later, for example Opening balances March.

steps.title: 4. File
steps.text: Choose the filled-in spreadsheet.

steps.title: 5. Check File
steps.text: Click Check File. Nothing is loaded yet.

steps.title: 6. The check
steps.text: Clean rows on one side, rejected rows with the reason on the other. Error File downloads the rejected rows to fix and load again.

steps.title: 7. Load Clean Rows
steps.text: Loads the clean rows only.

steps.title: Past loads
steps.text: Every load, with its counts, when and by whom.

guides.title: Book leave for many people at once
guides.blurb: A shutdown or company day: check who it works for, then send one request per person.

steps.title: Bulk Leave
steps.text: Click Bulk Leave.

steps.title: 1. Leave type
steps.text: Which leave it comes from.

steps.title: 2. Dates and reason
steps.text: The first and last day, and the reason, for example December shutdown.

steps.title: 3. Who
steps.text: A unit or all your staff; filter the list, then tick people (or tick the top box for everyone).

steps.title: 4. Check Who Can Go
steps.text: Click it to see who it works for and who it doesn't.

steps.title: 5. The check
steps.text: For each person: the days and their balance afterwards. Anyone it doesn't work for is listed with the reason.

steps.title: 6. Submit Requests
steps.text: Creates one request per person. Each goes through the normal approval.

guides.title: Set who approves requests
guides.blurb: Set the 1st, 2nd and 3rd approver for a department or one employee.

steps.title: Global Settings
steps.text: Approval routing lives here. Click Global Settings.

steps.title: Workflow Routing
steps.text: Click Workflow Routing.

steps.title: 1. For a department
steps.text: Search and choose the department. The rule applies to everyone in it.

steps.title: Or for one person
steps.text: Choose an employee instead to give them their own approvers. This overrides their department's rule.

steps.title: 2. The approvers
steps.text: The 1st approver sees the request first. When they approve, it goes to the 2nd, then the 3rd. Leave a level empty to stop there.

steps.title: 3. Standing / Backup
steps.text: Who approves when the person at that level isn't set or isn't available.

steps.title: 4. Save Routing Rule
steps.text: Saves the rule. Requests from then on follow it.

steps.title: Your rules
steps.text: Every department and personal rule, with its approvers.

guides.title: Send a message to the app
guides.blurb: Send a notice to everyone, a department or one person in the mobile app and portal.

steps.title: Global Broadcasts
steps.text: Click Global Broadcasts.

steps.title: 1. Title
steps.text: A short heading, for example Payday moved to Thursday.

steps.title: 2. Message
steps.text: What people need to know.

steps.title: 3. Who gets it
steps.text: Everyone, a department, one person, or a custom list. Then choose which.

steps.title: 4. Attachment (optional)
steps.text: A file to go with it, such as a notice or a form.

steps.title: 5. Send Broadcast
steps.text: It appears straight away. Click Send (or skip it if you're only practising).

guides.title: Add a claim type
guides.blurb: Set up something people can claim for: how the amount is worked out, the receipt rules, approval and payroll code.

steps.title: Claims
steps.text: Click Claims.

steps.title: Claim Types
steps.text: The claim types live on this tab (they were on Expense Policies).

steps.title: New claim type
steps.text: Click New claim type.

steps.title: Name, description and icon
steps.text: For example Travel - own vehicle, a short description people see when they choose it, and an icon.

steps.title: How the amount is worked out
steps.text: Amount: the employee enters it. Quantity x rate: they enter how many (km, nights...) and it is multiplied by your rate. Fixed amount: always the same. Switch on Ask where from and to for trips.

steps.title: Receipt rules
steps.text: Make the receipt photo mandatory (optionally only above an amount) and camera only so an old gallery photo cannot be used. The phone and ESS follow these rules.

steps.title: Approval
steps.text: Full approval route, or Manager only - the first approver's approval is final for this type.

steps.title: Payroll / GL code
steps.text: Goes into the exports and the claim PDF, so payroll can book it.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: Click Save (or Cancel if you are only practising).
